query: Which survey techniques (self-administered modules, randomized response, anchoring vignettes, behavioral benchmarks) most reduce social desirability in African settings and how best to validate them?

response.query: Which survey techniques (self-administered modules, randomized response, anchoring vignettes, behavioral benchmarks) most reduce social desirability in African settings and how best to validate them?
response.answer: Anchoring vignettes and randomized response techniques most reduce social desirability in African settings; validation can use cross-checks with administrative data.
